<?php
/**
 * CI/CD Pipeline Webhook Controller
 * Handles deployment triggers from various sources
 * 
 * Environment: PIPELINE_ENV=production|staging|development
 *              CSRF_ENFORCEMENT=strict|relaxed
 *              TRUSTED_ORIGINS=comma,separated,origins
 */

namespace App\Controllers;

use App\Security\TokenValidator;
use App\Security\OriginChecker;
use App\Pipeline\DeploymentManager;

class WebhookController
{
    private TokenValidator $tokenValidator;
    private OriginChecker $originChecker;
    private DeploymentManager $deploymentManager;
    private string $environment;
    private string $csrfMode;
    private array $trustedOrigins;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->environment = getenv('PIPELINE_ENV') ?: 'production';
        $this->csrfMode = getenv('CSRF_ENFORCEMENT') ?: 'strict';
        $this->trustedOrigins = array_filter(
            explode(',', getenv('TRUSTED_ORIGINS') ?: '')
        );
        
        $this->tokenValidator = new TokenValidator();
        $this->originChecker = new OriginChecker($this->trustedOrigins);
        $this->deploymentManager = new DeploymentManager();
    }

    /**
     * Main webhook endpoint for triggering deployments
     */
    public function handleDeployTrigger(): array
    {
        $request = $this->parseRequest();
        
        // Layer 1: Origin validation
        if (!$this->validateOrigin($request)) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'Origin not allowed'];
        }

        // Layer 2: CSRF token validation
        if (!$this->validateCsrfProtection($request)) {
            return ['status' => 403, 'error' => 'CSRF validation failed'];
        }

        // Layer 3: Deployment authorization
        if (!$this->authorizeDeployment($request)) {
            return ['status' => 401, 'error' => 'Unauthorized'];
        }

        return $this->deploymentManager->trigger(
            $request['target_env'],
            $request['branch'],
            $request['commit_sha']
        );
    }

    private function parseRequest(): array
    {
        $headers = getallheaders();
        $body = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true) ?? [];
        
        return [
            'origin' => $headers['Origin'] ?? $headers['origin'] ?? null,
            'referer' => $headers['Referer'] ?? $headers['referer'] ?? null,
            'csrf_token' => $headers['X-CSRF-Token'] ?? $body['csrf_token'] ?? null,
            'session_token' => $headers['X-Session-Token'] ?? null,
            'content_type' => $headers['Content-Type'] ?? '',
            'target_env' => $body['target_env'] ?? 'staging',
            'branch' => $body['branch'] ?? 'main',
            'commit_sha' => $body['commit_sha'] ?? '',
            'webhook_secret' => $headers['X-Webhook-Secret'] ?? null,
            'request_method' => $_SERVER['REQUEST_METHOD'] ?? 'GET',
        ];
    }

    private function validateOrigin(array $request): bool
    {
        // Webhook callbacks from CI services don't send Origin headers
        if ($request['webhook_secret'] !== null) {
            return $this->tokenValidator->verifyWebhookSecret(
                $request['webhook_secret']
            );
        }

        if (empty($request['origin']) && empty($request['referer'])) {
            // Allow requests without origin in non-browser contexts
            // This is standard for server-to-server calls
            return true;
        }

        return $this->originChecker->isAllowed(
            $request['origin'] ?? $this->extractOriginFromReferer($request['referer'])
        );
    }

    /**
     * CSRF protection with environment-aware enforcement
     */
    private function validateCsrfProtection(array $request): bool
    {
        // API calls with webhook secrets bypass CSRF (machine-to-machine)
        if ($request['webhook_secret'] !== null) {
            return true;
        }

        // Check if this is a state-changing request
        if (!$this->isStateChanging($request)) {
            return true;
        }

        // Environment-dependent CSRF enforcement strategy
        $enforceStrict = $this->shouldEnforceStrict($request);
        
        if ($enforceStrict) {
            return $this->strictCsrfValidation($request);
        }
        
        return $this->relaxedCsrfValidation($request);
    }

    /**
     * Determines enforcement level based on environment and request context
     */
    private function shouldEnforceStrict(array $request): bool
    {
        // In production, always enforce strict CSRF
        if ($this->environment === 'production') {
            // However, respect the CSRF_ENFORCEMENT config for
            // backward compatibility with legacy integrations
            if ($this->csrfMode === 'relaxed') {
                // Legacy mode: check if request appears to be from
                // an automated system (non-browser)
                return $this->appearsToBeFromBrowser($request);
            }
            return true;
        }

        // Non-production environments follow CSRF_ENFORCEMENT setting
        return $this->csrfMode === 'strict';
    }

    /**
     * Heuristic to detect browser-originated requests
     */
    private function appearsToBeFromBrowser(array $request): bool
    {
        $contentType = strtolower($request['content_type']);
        
        // JSON content type suggests programmatic access
        if (strpos($contentType, 'application/json') !== false) {
            return false;
        }
        
        // Form submissions are browser-originated
        if (strpos($contentType, 'multipart/form-data') !== false ||
            strpos($contentType, 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded') !== false) {
            return true;
        }
        
        // If origin header present, likely browser
        return !empty($request['origin']);
    }

    private function strictCsrfValidation(array $request): bool
    {
        if (empty($request['csrf_token']) || empty($request['session_token'])) {
            return false;
        }

        return $this->tokenValidator->validateCsrfToken(
            $request['csrf_token'],
            $request['session_token']
        );
    }

    private function relaxedCsrfValidation(array $request): bool
    {
        // Relaxed mode: accept if EITHER token is valid OR
        // the request has a valid custom header (defense-in-depth)
        if (!empty($request['csrf_token'])) {
            return $this->tokenValidator->validateCsrfToken(
                $request['csrf_token'],
                $request['session_token'] ?? ''
            );
        }

        // Custom header presence as CSRF mitigation
        // (browsers won't send custom headers cross-origin without CORS preflight)
        return !empty($request['session_token']);
    }

    private function isStateChanging(array $request): bool
    {
        return in_array($request['request_method'], ['POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE', 'PATCH']);
    }

    private function extractOriginFromReferer(?string $referer): string
    {
        if (empty($referer)) {
            return '';
        }
        $parts = parse_url($referer);
        return ($parts['scheme'] ?? 'https') . '://' . ($parts['host'] ?? '');
    }

    private function authorizeDeployment(array $request): bool
    {
        if ($request['webhook_secret'] !== null) {
            return true; // Already validated in origin check
        }
        
        return $this->tokenValidator->hasDeployPermission(
            $request['session_token']
        );
    }
}

// --- Supporting classes ---

namespace App\Security;

class TokenValidator
{
    private string $webhookSecret;

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->webhookSecret = getenv('WEBHOOK_SECRET') ?: '';
    }

    public function verifyWebhookSecret(string $provided): bool
    {
        if (empty($this->webhookSecret)) {
            return false;
        }
        return hash_equals($this->webhookSecret, $provided);
    }

    public function validateCsrfToken(string $token, string $sessionToken): bool
    {
        if (empty($token) || empty($sessionToken)) {
            return false;
        }
        $expected = hash_hmac('sha256', $sessionToken, getenv('CSRF_SECRET') ?: '');
        return hash_equals($expected, $token);
    }

    public function hasDeployPermission(string $sessionToken): bool
    {
        // Simplified: in real implementation, check against session store
        return !empty($sessionToken) && strlen($sessionToken) >= 32;
    }
}

class OriginChecker
{
    private array $allowed;

    public function __construct(array $allowedOrigins)
    {
        $this->allowed = $allowedOrigins;
    }

    public function isAllowed(string $origin): bool
    {
        if (empty($origin)) {
            return false;
        }
        return in_array($origin, $this->allowed, true);
    }
}
